name: DICTO Jewel-cube cluster R (unified): eight Jewel cubes at the corners of the FCC(4) primitive cell, G inside, one solid
units: unit: Jewel cube inner edge 1 (raw x 1/4)
notes: Cube analogue of the Jewel rhombohedron: 18 window-mating pairs (36 whole windows), G sealed inside (touching the outside at the two axial cubes' corner points). Volume 8 x 80 + 48.
